skills.name: Make common denominators
skills.definition: Find an LCD for unlike denominators and rewrite each relevant fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator, including cases with zero or equal numerators.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed-number parts
skills.definition: For mixed numbers or whole-number operands, separate or rewrite whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the resulting parts.

skills.name: Regroup by borrowing from wholes
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, regroup one or more whole units as denominator-sized fractional units before subtracting.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their common factor.

skills.name: Find and use common denominators
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator, typically the LCD, and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and expressing the fractional result in acceptable simplest form.

skills.name: Work with mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole-number operands into whole-number and fractional parts, represent missing parts as zero when needed, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including cases with zero or negative intermediate fractional results.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts using zero for missing parts, and recombine the final result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole-fraction boundary
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes as denominator-over-denominator fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms.

skills.name: Find and use common denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and convert the fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole-number operands into aligned whole and fractional parts, use zero for missing parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and express zero fractional parts or whole-number results in standard form.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite the relevant fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Handle whole parts in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, use zero for missing parts, subtract whole parts, and assemble the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-equivalent fractional units when the minuend fractional part is too small to subtract.

skills.name: Simplify final form
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and convert a zero fractional part to an integer final form when appropriate.
